doc.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023

title: The second movement of 'Developing Story'
summary: Rowe praises hearing new countermelodies on a second listen; Broadbent notes the second movement uses the same theme upside down.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I had that with my second listen through to back to your “Developing Story,” the first movement, only the second time I was hearing things I hadn’t heard before, some counter melodies in the cello and so forth. Very beautiful.
But then again the second movement is kind of a movement d’amore. But it’s the same theme only cleverly composed upside-down which people will eventually get.
Okay. I think I learned about that in music theory, something about a retrograde something.
You’ve got it. There you go.
